spinner: A yellow box is lifted off its hard shadow, turned a quarter in the air and dropped back onto it, over and over.
skeleton: Yellow, lavender and sky plates with ink outlines, pressed down onto their shadows one after another like keys.
switch: A chunky square slider with its own hard shadow; on, the track turns ink and the block turns yellow, snapping across.
check: Square ink-ruled boxes on a hard shadow; the heavy ink tick is stamped in on a yellow plate, and the radio is a lavender disc with an ink dot.
toast: A yellow plate held up askew, then dropped flat exactly onto where its hard shadow lies.
dialog: A slab on a flat lavender table: thick ink frame, a deep hard shadow, the title in heavy capitals on a yellow bar, dropped into place.
tooltip: A sky-blue sticker with an ink edge, a hard shadow and an ink arrow, dropped under the button.
steps: Numbered blocks on hard shadows joined by thick ink bars: done ones ink, the current one yellow and lifted higher off its shadow.
empty: An empty crate: a heavy ink frame with a big zero on a tilted lavender price sticker above a heavy capital title.
link: A bold word with a thick ink underline; under the pointer it sits on a yellow plate with an ink edge and a hard shadow.
